items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So the piano player, Wilcox, he asked me could I make the week with them. So I made the week.

ctx.x: time, about this time, too. That's before you got the steady day job.

Yeah. I just sat in for somebody. Let me see, Willie Smith had just left the band or something. I don't know who that was. No, I was in Simeon's place. Simeon used to be in the band. Simeon, I think, was sick. He had taken sick. And they had to open at this theatre up in the Bronx. So the piano player, Wilcox, he asked me could I make the week with them. So it was all right with me as far as I'm concerned. So I made the week. You know, no big deal about that. It was just a week, just like you said. That was all…
Because I guess Wilcox had taken over the band at that time.
